Slots.comments: If known, provide the degrees longitude.  Do NOT simply provide longitude of the institution if this is not where the sample was collected, nor the centre of the city/region where the sample was collected as this falsely implicates an existing geographical location and creates data inaccuracies. If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: sample_collection_date
Slots.title: sample_collection_date
Slots.description: The date on which the sample was collected.
Slots.comments: Provide the date according to the ISO 8601 standard "YYYY-MM-DD", "YYYY-MM" or "YYYY".

Slots.name: sample_collection_date_precision
Slots.title: sample_collection_date_precision
Slots.description: The precision to which the "sample collection date" was provided.
Slots.comments: Provide the precision of granularity to the "day", "month", or "year" for the date provided in the "sample collection date" field. The "sample collection date" will be truncated to the precision specified upon export; "day" for "YYYY-MM-DD", "month" for "YYYY-MM", or "year" for "YYYY".

Slots.name: sample_collection_end_date
Slots.title: sample_collection_end_date
Slots.description: The date on which sample collection ended for a continuous sample.
Slots.comments: Provide the date that sample collection ended in ISO 8601 format i.e. YYYY-MM-DD

Slots.name: sample_processing_date
Slots.title: sample_processing_date
Slots.description: The date on which the sample was processed.
Slots.comments: Provide the sample processed date in ISO 8601 format, i.e. "YYYY-MM-DD". The sample may be collected and processed (e.g. filtered, extraction) on the same day, or on different dates.

Slots.name: sample_collection_start_time
Slots.title: sample_collection_start_time
Slots.description: The time at which sample collection began.
Slots.comments: Provide this time in ISO 8601 24hr format, in your local time.

Slots.name: sample_collection_end_time
Slots.title: sample_collection_end_time
Slots.description: The time at which sample collection ended.
Slots.comments: Provide this time in ISO 8601 24hr format, in your local time.

Slots.name: sample_collection_time_of_day
Slots.title: sample_collection_time_of_day
Slots.description: The descriptive time of day during which the sample was collected.
Slots.comments: If known, select a value from the pick list. The time of sample processing matters especially for grab samples, as fecal concentration in wastewater fluctuates over the course of the day.

Slots.name: sample_collection_time_duration_value
Slots.title: sample_collection_time_duration_value
Slots.description: The amount of time over which the sample was collected.
Slots.comments: Provide the numerical value of time.

Slots.name: sample_collection_time_duration_unit
Slots.title: sample_collection_time_duration_unit
Slots.description: The units of the time duration measurement of sample collection.
Slots.comments: Provide the units from the pick list.

Slots.name: sample_received_date
Slots.title: sample_received_date
Slots.description: The date on which the sample was received.
Slots.comments: Provide the date according to the ISO 8601 standard "YYYY-MM-DD", "YYYY-MM" or "YYYY".

Slots.name: original_sample_description
Slots.title: original_sample_description
Slots.description: The original sample description provided by the sample collector.
Slots.comments: Provide the sample description provided by the original sample collector. The original description is useful as it may provide further details, or can be used to clarify higher level classifications.

Slots.name: environmental_site
Slots.title: environmental_site
Slots.description: An environmental location may describe a site in the natural or built environment e.g. hospital, wet market, bat cave.
Slots.comments: If applicable, select the standardized term and ontology ID for the environmental site from the picklist provided. Multiple values can be provided, separated by a semi-colon.

Slots.name: environmental_material
Slots.title: environmental_material
Slots.description: A substance obtained from the natural or man-made environment e.g. soil, water, sewage, door handle, bed handrail, face mask.
Slots.comments: If applicable, select the standardized term and ontology ID for the environmental material from the picklist provided. Multiple values can be provided, separated by a semi-colon.

Slots.name: environmental_material_constituent
Slots.title: environmental_material_constituent
Slots.description: The material constituents that comprise an environmental material e.g. lead, plastic, paper.
Slots.comments: If applicable, describe the material constituents for the environmental material. Multiple values can be provided, separated by a semi-colon.

Slots.name: animal_or_plant_population
Slots.title: animal_or_plant_population
Slots.description: The type of animal or plant population inhabiting an area.
Slots.comments: This field should be used when a sample is taken from an environmental location inhabited by many individuals of a specific type, rather than describing a sample taken from one particular host. If applicable, provide the standardized term and ontology ID for the animal or plant population name. The standardized term can be sourced from this look-up service: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols/ontologies/genepio. If not applicable, leave blank.

Slots.name: anatomical_material
Slots.title: anatomical_material
Slots.description: A substance obtained from an anatomical part of an organism e.g. tissue, blood.
Slots.comments: An anatomical material is a substance taken from the body. If applicable, select the standardized term and ontology ID for the anatomical material from the picklist provided. Multiple values can be provided, separated by a semi-colon.

Slots.name: body_product
Slots.title: body_product
Slots.description: A substance excreted/secreted from an organism e.g. feces, urine, sweat.
Slots.comments: A body product is a substance produced by the body but meant to be excreted/secreted (i.e. not part of the body). If applicable, select the standardized term and ontology ID for the body product from the picklist provided. Multiple values can be provided, separated by a semi-colon.

Slots.name: anatomical_part
Slots.title: anatomical_part
Slots.description: An anatomical part of an organism e.g. oropharynx.
Slots.comments: An anatomical part is a structure or location in the body. If applicable, select the standardized term and ontology ID for the anatomical material from the picklist provided. Multiple values can be provided, separated by a semi-colon.

Slots.name: anatomical_region
Slots.title: anatomical_region
Slots.description: A 3D region in space without well-defined compartmental boundaries; for example, the dorsal region of an ectoderm.
Slots.comments: This field captures more granular spatial information on a host anatomical part e.g. dorso-lateral region vs back. Select a term from the picklist.

Slots.name: food_product
Slots.title: food_product
Slots.description: A material consumed and digested for nutritional value or enjoyment.
Slots.comments: This field includes animal feed. If applicable, select the standardized term and ontology ID for the anatomical material from the picklist provided. Multiple values can be provided, separated by a semi-colon.

Slots.name: food_product_properties
Slots.title: food_product_properties
Slots.description: Any characteristic of the food product pertaining to its state, processing, or implications for consumers.
Slots.comments: Provide any characteristics of the food product including whether it has been cooked, processed, preserved, any known information about its state (e.g. raw, ready-to-eat), any known information about its containment (e.g. canned), and any information about a label claim (e.g. organic, fat-free).

Slots.name: label_claim
Slots.title: label_claim
Slots.description: The claim made by the label that relates to food processing, allergen information etc.
Slots.comments: Provide any characteristic of the food product, as described on the label only.

Slots.name: animal_source_of_food
Slots.title: animal_source_of_food
Slots.description: The animal from which the food product was derived.
Slots.comments: Provide the common name of the animal. If not applicable, leave blank. Multiple entries can be provided, separated by a comma.

Slots.name: food_product_production_stream
Slots.title: food_product_production_stream
Slots.description: A production pathway incorporating the processes, material entities (e.g. equipment, animals, locations), and conditions that participate in the generation of a food commodity.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the agricultural production stream from the picklist.

Slots.name: food_packaging
Slots.title: food_packaging
Slots.description: The type of packaging used to contain a food product.
Slots.comments: If known, provide information regarding how the food product was packaged.

Slots.name: food_quality_date
Slots.title: food_quality_date
Slots.description: A date recommended for the use of a product while at peak quality, this date is not a reflection of safety unless used on infant formula.
Slots.comments: This date is typically labeled on a food product as "best if used by", best by", "use by", or "freeze by" e.g. 5/24/2020. If the date is known, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: food_packaging_date
Slots.title: food_packaging_date
Slots.description: A food product's packaging date as marked by a food manufacturer or retailer.
Slots.comments: The packaging date should not be confused with, nor replaced by a Best Before date or other food quality date. If the date is known, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: collection_device
Slots.title: collection_device
Slots.description: The instrument or container used to collect the sample e.g. swab.
Slots.comments: This field includes animal feed. If applicable, select the standardized term and ontology ID for the anatomical material from the picklist provided. Multiple values can be provided, separated by a semi-colon.

Slots.name: collection_method
Slots.title: collection_method
Slots.description: The process used to collect the sample e.g. phlebotomy, necropsy.
Slots.comments: If applicable, provide the standardized term and ontology ID for the anatomical material from the picklist provided. Multiple values can be provided, separated by a semi-colon.

Slots.name: sample_volume_measurement_value
Slots.title: sample_volume_measurement_value
Slots.description: The numerical value of the volume measurement of the sample collected.
Slots.comments: Provide the numerical value of volume.

Slots.name: sample_volume_measurement_unit
Slots.title: sample_volume_measurement_unit
Slots.description: The units of the volume measurement of the sample collected.
Slots.comments: Provide the units from the pick list.

Slots.name: residual_sample_status
Slots.title: residual_sample_status
Slots.description: The status of the residual sample (whether any sample remains after its original use).
Slots.comments: Residual samples are samples that remain after the sample material was used for its original purpose. Select a residual sample status from the picklist. If sample still exists, select "Residual sample remaining (some sample left)".

Slots.name: sample_storage_method
Slots.title: sample_storage_method
Slots.description: A specification of the way that a specimen is or was stored.
Slots.comments: Provide a description of how the sample was stored.

Slots.name: sample_storage_medium
Slots.title: sample_storage_medium
Slots.description: The material or matrix in which a sample is stored.
Slots.comments: Provide a description of the medium in which the sample was stored.

Slots.name: sample_storage_duration_value
Slots.title: sample_storage_duration_value
Slots.description: The numerical value of the time measurement during which a sample is in storage.
Slots.comments: Provide the numerical value of time.

Slots.name: sample_storage_duration_unit
Slots.title: sample_storage_duration_unit
Slots.description: The units of a measured sample storage duration.
Slots.comments: Provide the units from the pick list.

Slots.name: nucleic_acid_storage_duration_value
Slots.title: nucleic_acid_storage_duration_value
Slots.description: The numerical value of the time measurement during which the extracted nucleic acid is in storage.
Slots.comments: Provide the numerical value of time.

Slots.name: nucleic_acid_storage_duration_unit
Slots.title: nucleic_acid_storage_duration_unit
Slots.description: The units of a measured extracted nucleic acid storage duration.
Slots.comments: Provide the units from the pick list.

Slots.name: available_data_types
Slots.title: available_data_types
Slots.description: The type of data that is available, that may or may not require permission to access.
Slots.comments: This field provides information about additional data types that are available that may provide context for interpretation of the sequence data. Provide a term from the picklist for additional data types that are available. Additional data types may require special permission to access. Contact the data provider for more information.

Slots.name: available_data_type_details
Slots.title: available_data_type_details
Slots.description: Detailed information regarding other available data types.
Slots.comments: Use this field to provide free text details describing other available data types that may provide context for interpreting genomic sequence data.
Slots.examples: Pooled metagenomes containing extended spectrum beta-lactamase (ESBL) bacteria

Slots.name: water_depth
Slots.title: water_depth
Slots.description: The depth of some water.
Slots.comments: Provide the numerical depth only  of water only (without units).

Slots.name: water_depth_units
Slots.title: water_depth_units
Slots.description: The units of measurement for water depth.
Slots.comments: Provide the units of measurement for which the depth was recorded.

Slots.name: sediment_depth
Slots.title: sediment_depth
Slots.description: The depth of some sediment.
Slots.comments: Provide the numerical depth only of the sediment (without units).

Slots.name: sediment_depth_units
Slots.title: sediment_depth_units
Slots.description: The units of measurement for sediment depth.
Slots.comments: Provide the units of measurement for which the depth was recorded.

Slots.name: air_temperature
Slots.title: air_temperature
Slots.description: The temperature of some air.
Slots.comments: Provide the numerical value for the temperature of the air (without units).

Slots.name: air_temperature_units
Slots.title: air_temperature_units
Slots.description: The units of measurement for air temperature.
Slots.comments: Provide the units of measurement for which the temperature was recorded.

Slots.name: water_temperature
Slots.title: water_temperature
Slots.description: The temperature of some water.
Slots.comments: Provide the numerical value for the temperature of the water (without units).

Slots.name: water_temperature_units
Slots.title: water_temperature_units
Slots.description: The units of measurement for water temperature.
Slots.comments: Provide the units of measurement for which the temperature was recorded.

Slots.name: sampling_weather_conditions
Slots.title: sampling_weather_conditions
Slots.description: The state of the atmosphere at a place and time as regards heat, dryness, sunshine, wind, rain, etc.
Slots.comments: Provide the weather conditions at the time of sample collection.

Slots.name: presampling_weather_conditions
Slots.title: presampling_weather_conditions
Slots.description: Weather conditions prior to collection that may affect the sample.
Slots.comments: Provide the weather conditions prior to sample collection.

Slots.name: precipitation_measurement_value
Slots.title: precipitation_measurement_value
Slots.description: The amount of water which has fallen during a precipitation process.
Slots.comments: Provide the quantity of precipitation in the area leading up to the time of sample collection.

Slots.name: precipitation_measurement_unit
Slots.title: precipitation_measurement_unit
Slots.description: The units of measurement for the amount of water which has fallen during a precipitation process.
Slots.comments: Provide the units of precipitation by selecting a value from the pick list.

Slots.name: precipitation_measurement_method
Slots.title: precipitation_measurement_method
Slots.description: The process used to measure the amount of water which has fallen during a precipitation process.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the procedure or method used to measure precipitation.
Slots.examples: Rain gauge over a 12 hour period prior to sample collection

Slots.name: host_common_name
Slots.title: host (common name)
Slots.description: The commonly used name of the host.
Slots.comments: If the sample is directly from a host, either a common or scientific name must be provided (although both can be included, if known).  If known, provide the common name.

Slots.name: host_scientific_name
Slots.title: host (scientific name)
Slots.description: The taxonomic, or scientific name of the host.
Slots.comments: If the sample is directly from a host, either a common or scientific name must be provided (although both can be included, if known).  If known, select the scientific name from the picklist provided.

Slots.name: host_ecotype
Slots.title: host (ecotype)
Slots.description: The biotype resulting from selection in a particular habitat, e.g. the A. thaliana Ecotype Ler.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the ecotype of the host organism.

Slots.name: host_breed
Slots.title: host (breed)
Slots.description: A breed is a specific group of domestic animals or plants having homogeneous appearance, homogeneous behavior, and other characteristics that distinguish it from other animals or plants of the same species and that were arrived at through selective breeding.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the breed of the host organism.

Slots.name: host_food_production_name
Slots.title: host (food production name)
Slots.description: The name of the host at a certain stage of food production, which may depend on its age or stage of sexual maturity.
Slots.comments: Select the host's food production name from the pick list.

Slots.name: host_age_bin
Slots.title: host_age_bin
Slots.description: Age of host at the time of sampling, expressed as an age group.
Slots.comments: Select the corresponding host age bin from the pick list provided in the template. If not available, provide a null value or leave blank.

Slots.name: host_disease
Slots.title: host_disease
Slots.description: The name of the disease experienced by the host.
Slots.comments: This field is only required if the Pathogen.cl package was selected. If the host was sick, provide the name of the disease.The standardized term can be sourced from this look-up service: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols/ontologies/doid If the disease is not known, put “missing”.

Slots.name: microbiological_method
Slots.title: microbiological_method
Slots.description: The laboratory method used to grow, prepare, and/or isolate the microbial isolate.
Slots.comments: Provide the name and version number of the microbiological method. The ID of the method is also acceptable if the ID can be linked to the laboratory that created the procedure.

Slots.name: strain
Slots.title: strain
Slots.description: The strain identifier.
Slots.comments: If the isolate represents or is derived from, a lab reference strain or strain from a type culture collection, provide the strain identifier.

Slots.name: organism
Slots.title: organism
Slots.description: Taxonomic name of the organism.
Slots.comments: Put the genus and species (and subspecies if applicable) of the bacteria, if known. The standardized term can be sourced from this look-up service: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols/ontologies/ncbitaxon. Note: If taxonomic identification was performed using metagenomic approaches, multiple organisms may be included. There is no need to list organisms detected as the result of noise in the data (only a few reads present). Only include organism names that you are confident are present. Also include the taxonomic mapping software and reference database(s) used.

Slots.name: taxonomic_identification_process
Slots.title: taxonomic_identification_process
Slots.description: The type of planned process by which an organismal entity is associated with a taxon or taxa.
Slots.comments: Provide the type of method used to determine the taxonomic identity of the organism by selecting a value from the pick list. If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: taxonomic_identification_process_details
Slots.title: taxonomic_identification_process_details
Slots.description: The details of the process used to determine the taxonomic identification of an organism.
Slots.comments: Briefly describe the taxonomic identififcation method details using free text.

Slots.name: serovar
Slots.title: serovar
Slots.description: The serovar of the organism.
Slots.comments: Only include this information if it has been determined by traditional serological methods or a validated in silico prediction tool e.g. SISTR.

Slots.name: serotyping_method
Slots.title: serotyping_method
Slots.description: The method used to determine the serovar.
Slots.comments: If the serovar was determined via traditional serotyping methods, put “Traditional serotyping”. If the serovar was determined via in silico methods, provide the name and version number of the software.

Slots.name: phagetype
Slots.title: phagetype
Slots.description: The phagetype of the organism.
Slots.comments: Provide if known. If unknown, put “missing”.

Slots.name: library_id
Slots.title: library_ID
Slots.description: The user-specified identifier for the library prepared for sequencing.
Slots.comments: Every "library ID" from a single submitter must be unique. It can have any format, but we suggest that you make it concise, unique and consistent within your lab, and as informative as possible.

Slots.name: sequenced_by
Slots.title: sequenced_by
Slots.description: The name of the agency, organization or institution responsible for sequencing the isolate's genome.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the agency, organization or institution that performed the sequencing in full (avoid abbreviations). If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: sequenced_by_laboratory_name
Slots.title: sequenced_by_laboratory_name
Slots.description: The specific laboratory affiliation of the responsible for sequencing the isolate's genome.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the specific laboratory that that performed the sequencing in full (avoid abbreviations). If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: sequenced_by_contact_name
Slots.title: sequenced_by_contact_name
Slots.description: The name or title of the contact responsible for follow-up regarding the sequence.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of an individual or their job title. As personnel turnover may render the contact's name obsolete, it is more prefereable to provide a job title for ensuring accuracy of information and institutional memory. If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: sequenced_by_contact_email
Slots.title: sequenced_by_contact_email
Slots.description: The email address of the contact responsible for follow-up regarding the sequence.
Slots.comments: Provide the email associated with the listed contact. As personnel turnover may render an individual's email obsolete, it is more prefereable to provide an address for a position or lab, to ensure accuracy of information and institutional memory. If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: purpose_of_sequencing
Slots.title: purpose_of_sequencing
Slots.description: The reason that the sample was sequenced.
Slots.comments: Provide the reason for sequencing by selecting a value from the following pick list: Diagnostic testing, Surveillance, Monitoring, Clinical trial, Field experiment, Environmental testing. If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: sequencing_date
Slots.title: sequencing_date
Slots.description: The date the sample was sequenced.
Slots.comments: ISO 8601 standard "YYYY-MM-DD".

Slots.name: sequencing_project_name
Slots.title: sequencing_project_name
Slots.description: The name of the project/initiative/program for which sequencing was performed.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the project and/or the project ID here. If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: sequencing_platform
Slots.title: sequencing_platform
Slots.description: The platform technology used to perform the sequencing.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the company that created the sequencing instrument by selecting a value from the template pick list. If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: sequencing_instrument
Slots.title: sequencing_instrument
Slots.description: The model of the sequencing instrument used.
Slots.comments: Provide the model sequencing instrument by selecting a value from the template pick list. If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: sequencing_assay_type
Slots.title: sequencing_assay_type
Slots.description: The overarching sequencing methodology that was used to determine the sequence of a biomaterial.
Slots.comments: Example Guidance: Provide the name of the DNA or RNA sequencing technology used in your study. If unsure refer to the protocol documentation, or provide a null value.

Slots.name: library_preparation_kit
Slots.title: library_preparation_kit
Slots.description: The name of the DNA library preparation kit used to generate the library being sequenced.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the library preparation kit used.

Slots.name: dna_fragment_length
Slots.title: DNA_fragment_length
Slots.description: The length of the DNA fragment generated by mechanical shearing or enzymatic digestion for the purposes of library preparation.
Slots.comments: Provide the fragment length in base pairs (do not include the units).

Slots.name: genomic_target_enrichment_method
Slots.title: genomic_target_enrichment_method
Slots.description: The molecular technique used to selectively capture and amplify specific regions of interest from a genome.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the enrichment method

Slots.name: genomic_target_enrichment_method_details
Slots.title: genomic_target_enrichment_method_details
Slots.description: Details that provide additional context to the molecular technique used to selectively capture and amplify specific regions of interest from a genome.
Slots.comments: Provide details that are applicable to the method you used. Note: If bait-capture methods were used for enrichment, provide the panel name and version number (or a URL providing that information).
Slots.examples: enrichment was done using Twist's respiratory virus research panel: https://www.twistbioscience.com/products/ngs/fixed-panels/respiratory-virus-research-panel

Slots.name: amplicon_pcr_primer_scheme
Slots.title: amplicon_pcr_primer_scheme
Slots.description: The specifications of the primers (primer sequences, binding positions, fragment size generated etc) used to generate the amplicons to be sequenced.
Slots.comments: Provide the name and version of the primer scheme used to generate the amplicons for sequencing.

Slots.name: amplicon_size
Slots.title: amplicon_size
Slots.description: The length of the amplicon generated by PCR amplification.
Slots.comments: Provide the amplicon size expressed in base pairs.

Slots.name: sequencing_flow_cell_version
Slots.title: sequencing_flow_cell_version
Slots.description: The version number of the flow cell used for generating sequence data.
Slots.comments: Flow cells can vary in terms of design, chemistry, capacity, etc. The version of the flow cell used to generate sequence data can affect sequence quantity and quality. Record the version of the flow cell used to generate sequence data. Do not include "version" or "v" in the version number.

Slots.name: sequencing_protocol
Slots.title: sequencing_protocol
Slots.description: The protocol or method used for sequencing.
Slots.comments: Provide the name and version of the procedure or protocol used for sequencing. You can also provide a link to a protocol online.

Slots.name: r1_fastq_filename
Slots.title: r1_fastq_filename
Slots.description: The user-specified filename of the r1 FASTQ file.
Slots.comments: Provide the r1 FASTQ filename.

Slots.name: r2_fastq_filename
Slots.title: r2_fastq_filename
Slots.description: The user-specified filename of the r2 FASTQ file.
Slots.comments: Provide the r2 FASTQ filename.

Slots.name: fast5_filename
Slots.title: fast5_filename
Slots.description: The user-specified filename of the FAST5 file.
Slots.comments: Provide the FAST5 filename.

Slots.name: genome_sequence_filename
Slots.title: genome_sequence_filename
Slots.description: The user-defined filename of the FASTA file.
Slots.comments: Provide the FASTA filename.

Slots.name: quality_control_method_name
Slots.title: quality_control_method_name
Slots.description: The name of the method used to assess whether a sequence passed a predetermined quality control threshold.
Slots.comments: Providing the name of the method used for quality control is very important for interpreting the rest of the QC information. Method names can be provided as the name of a pipeline or a link to a GitHub repository. Multiple methods should be listed and separated by a semi-colon. Do not include QC tags in other fields if no method name is provided.

Slots.name: quality_control_method_version
Slots.title: quality_control_method_version
Slots.description: The version number of the method used to assess whether a sequence passed a predetermined quality control threshold.
Slots.comments: Methods updates can make big differences to their outputs. Provide the version of the method used for quality control. The version can be expressed using whatever convention the developer implements (e.g. date, semantic versioning). If multiple methods were used, record the version numbers in the same order as the method names. Separate the version numbers using a semi-colon.

Slots.name: quality_control_determination
Slots.title: quality_control_determination
Slots.description: The determination of a quality control assessment.
Slots.comments: Select a value from the pick list provided. If a desired value is missing, submit a new term request to the PHA4GE QC Tag GitHub issuetracker using the New Term Request form.

Slots.name: quality_control_issues
Slots.title: quality_control_issues
Slots.description: The reason contributing to, or causing, a low quality determination in a quality control assessment.
Slots.comments: Select a value from the pick list provided. If a desired value is missing, submit a new term request to the PHA4GE QC Tag GitHub issuetracker using the New Term Request form.

Slots.name: quality_control_details
Slots.title: quality_control_details
Slots.description: The details surrounding a low quality determination in a quality control assessment.
Slots.comments: Provide notes or details regarding QC results using free text.
Slots.examples: CT value of 39. Low viral load. Low DNA concentration after amplification.

Slots.name: raw_sequence_data_processing_method
Slots.title: raw_sequence_data_processing_method
Slots.description: The method used for raw data processing such as removing barcodes, adapter trimming, filtering etc.
Slots.comments: Raw data processing can have a significant impact on data quality and how it can be used. Provide the names and version numbers of software used for trimming adaptors, quality filtering, etc (e.g. Trimmomatic v. 0.38, Porechop v. 0.2.3), or a link to a GitHub protocol.

Slots.name: dehosting_method
Slots.title: dehosting_method
Slots.description: The method used to remove host reads from the pathogen sequence.
Slots.comments: Provide the name and version number of the software used to remove host reads.

Slots.name: sequence_assembly_software_name
Slots.title: sequence_assembly_software_name
Slots.description: The name of the software used to assemble a sequence.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the software used to assemble the sequence.
Slots.examples: SPAdes Genome Assembler, Canu, wtdbg2, velvet

Slots.name: sequence_assembly_software_version
Slots.title: sequence_assembly_software_version
Slots.description: The version of the software used to assemble a sequence.
Slots.comments: Provide the version of the software used to assemble the sequence.

Slots.name: consensus_sequence_software_name
Slots.title: consensus_sequence_software_name
Slots.description: The name of the software used to generate the consensus sequence.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the software used to generate the consensus sequence.

Slots.name: consensus_sequence_software_version
Slots.title: consensus_sequence_software_version
Slots.description: The version of the software used to generate the consensus sequence.
Slots.comments: Provide the version of the software used to generate the consensus sequence.

Slots.name: breadth_of_coverage_value
Slots.title: breadth_of_coverage_value
Slots.description: The percentage of the reference genome covered by the sequenced data, to a prescribed depth.
Slots.comments: Provide value as a percent.

Slots.name: depth_of_coverage_value
Slots.title: depth_of_coverage_value
Slots.description: The average number of reads representing a given nucleotide in the reconstructed sequence.
Slots.comments: Provide value as a fold of coverage.

Slots.name: depth_of_coverage_threshold
Slots.title: depth_of_coverage_threshold
Slots.description: The threshold used as a cut-off for the depth of coverage.
Slots.comments: Provide the threshold fold coverage.

Slots.name: genome_completeness
Slots.title: genome_completeness
Slots.description: The percentage of expected genes identified in the genome being sequenced. Missing genes indicate missing genomic regions (incompleteness) in the data.
Slots.comments: Provide the genome completeness as a percent (no need to include units).

Slots.name: number_of_base_pairs_sequenced
Slots.title: number_of_base_pairs_sequenced
Slots.description: The number of total base pairs generated by the sequencing process.
Slots.comments: Provide a numerical value (no need to include units).

Slots.name: number_of_total_reads
Slots.title: number_of_total_reads
Slots.description: The total number of non-unique reads generated by the sequencing process.
Slots.comments: Provide a numerical value (no need to include units).

Slots.name: number_of_unique_reads
Slots.title: number_of_unique_reads
Slots.description: The number of unique reads generated by the sequencing process.
Slots.comments: Provide a numerical value (no need to include units).

Slots.name: minimum_posttrimming_read_length
Slots.title: minimum_post-trimming_read_length
Slots.description: The threshold used as a cut-off for the minimum length of a read after trimming.
Slots.comments: Provide a numerical value (no need to include units).

Slots.name: number_of_contigs
Slots.title: number_of_contigs
Slots.description: The number of contigs (contiguous sequences) in a sequence assembly.
Slots.comments: Provide a numerical value.

Slots.name: percent_ns_across_total_genome_length
Slots.title: percent_Ns_across_total_genome_length
Slots.description: The percentage of the assembly that consists of ambiguous bases (Ns).
Slots.comments: Provide a numerical value (no need to include units).

Slots.name: ns_per_100_kbp
Slots.title: Ns_per_100_kbp
Slots.description: The number of ambiguous bases (Ns) normalized per 100 kilobasepairs (kbp).
Slots.comments: Provide a numerical value (no need to include units).

Slots.name: n50
Slots.title: N50
Slots.description: The length of the shortest read that, together with other reads, represents at least 50% of the nucleotides in a set of sequences.
Slots.comments: Provide the N50 value in Mb.

Slots.name: percent_read_contamination_
Slots.title: percent_read_contamination
Slots.description: The percent of the total number of reads identified as contamination (not belonging to the target organism) in a sequence dataset.
Slots.comments: Provide the percent contamination value (no need to include units).

Slots.name: sequence_assembly_length
Slots.title: sequence_assembly_length
Slots.description: The length of the genome generated by assembling reads using a scaffold or by reference-based mapping.
Slots.comments: Provide a numerical value (no need to include units).

Slots.name: consensus_genome_length
Slots.title: consensus_genome_length
Slots.description: The length of the genome defined by the most common nucleotides at each position.
Slots.comments: Provide a numerical value (no need to include units).

Slots.name: reference_genome_accession
Slots.title: reference_genome_accession
Slots.description: A persistent, unique identifier of a genome database entry.
Slots.comments: Provide the accession number of the reference genome.

Slots.name: deduplication_method
Slots.title: deduplication_method
Slots.description: The method used to remove duplicated reads in a sequence read dataset.
Slots.comments: Provide the deduplication software name followed by the version, or a link to a tool or method.

Slots.name: bioinformatics_protocol
Slots.title: bioinformatics_protocol
Slots.description: A description of the overall bioinformatics strategy used.
Slots.comments: Further details regarding the methods used to process raw data, and/or generate assemblies, and/or generate consensus sequences can. This information can be provided in an SOP or protocol or pipeline/workflow. Provide the name and version number of the protocol, or a GitHub link to a pipeline or workflow.

Slots.name: read_mapping_software_name
Slots.title: read_mapping_software_name
Slots.description: The name of the software used to map sequence reads to a reference genome or set of reference genes.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the read mapping software.

Slots.name: read_mapping_software_version
Slots.title: read_mapping_software_version
Slots.description: The version of the software used to map sequence reads to a reference genome or set of reference genes.
Slots.comments: Provide the version number of the read mapping software.

Slots.name: taxonomic_reference_database_name
Slots.title: taxonomic_reference_database_name
Slots.description: The name of the taxonomic reference database used to identify the organism.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the taxonomic reference database.

Slots.name: taxonomic_reference_database_version
Slots.title: taxonomic_reference_database_version
Slots.description: The version of the taxonomic reference database used to identify the organism.
Slots.comments: Provide the version number of the taxonomic reference database.

Slots.name: taxonomic_analysis_report_filename
Slots.title: taxonomic_analysis_report_filename
Slots.description: The filename of the report containing the results of a taxonomic analysis.
Slots.comments: Provide the filename of the report containing the results of the taxonomic analysis.

Slots.name: taxonomic_analysis_date
Slots.title: taxonomic_analysis_date
Slots.description: The date a taxonomic analysis was performed.
Slots.comments: Providing the date that an analyis was performed can help provide context for tool and reference database versions. Provide the date that the taxonomic analysis was performed in ISO 8601 format, i.e. "YYYY-MM-DD".

Slots.name: read_mapping_criteria
Slots.title: read_mapping_criteria
Slots.description: A description of the criteria used to map reads to a reference sequence.
Slots.comments: Provide a description of the read mapping criteria.

Slots.name: sequence_submitted_by
Slots.title: sequence_submitted_by
Slots.description: The name of the agency that submitted the sequence to a database.
Slots.comments: The name of the agency should be written out in full, (with minor exceptions) and be consistent across multiple submissions. If submitting specimens rather than sequencing data, please put the "National Microbiology Laboratory (NML)".

Slots.name: sequence_submitted_by_contact_name
Slots.title: sequence_submitted_by_contact_name
Slots.description: The name or title of the contact responsible for follow-up regarding the submission of the sequence to a repository or database.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of an individual or their job title. As personnel turnover may render the contact's name obsolete, it is prefereable to provide a job title for ensuring accuracy of information and institutional memory. If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: sequence_submitted_by_contact_email
Slots.title: sequence_submitted_by_contact_email
Slots.description: The email address of the agency responsible for submission of the sequence.
Slots.comments: The email address can represent a specific individual or lab e.g. johnnyblogs@lab.ca, or RespLab@lab.ca

Slots.name: publication_id
Slots.title: publication_ID
Slots.description: The identifier for a publication.
Slots.comments: If the isolate is associated with a published work which can provide additional information, provide the PubMed identifier of the publication. Other types of identifiers (e.g. DOI) are also acceptable.

Slots.name: attribute_package
Slots.title: attribute_package
Slots.description: The attribute package used to structure metadata in an INSDC BioSample.
Slots.comments: If the sample is from a specific human or animal, put “Pathogen.cl”. If the sample is from an environmental sample including food, feed, production facility, farm, water source, manure etc, put “Pathogen.env”.

Slots.name: bioproject_accession
Slots.title: bioproject_accession
Slots.description: The INSDC accession number of the BioProject(s) to which the BioSample belongs.
Slots.comments: Required if submission is linked to a BioProject. BioProjects are an organizing tool that links together raw sequence data, assemblies, and their associated metadata. A valid BioProject accession has prefix PRJN, PRJE or PRJD, e.g., PRJNA12345 and is created once at the beginning of a new sequencing project. Your laboratory can have one or many BioProjects.

Slots.name: biosample_accession
Slots.title: biosample_accession
Slots.description: The identifier assigned to a BioSample in INSDC archives.
Slots.comments: Store the accession returned from the BioSample submission. NCBI BioSamples will have the prefix SAMN, whileEMBL- EBI BioSamples will have the prefix SAMEA.

Slots.name: sra_accession
Slots.title: SRA_accession
Slots.description: The Sequence Read Archive (SRA), European Nucleotide Archive (ENA) or DDBJ Sequence Read Archive (DRA) identifier linking raw read data, methodological metadata and quality control metrics submitted to the INSDC.
Slots.comments: Store the accession assigned to the submitted "run". NCBI-SRA accessions start with SRR, EBI-ENA runs start with ERR and DRA accessions start with DRR.

Slots.name: genbank_accession
Slots.title: GenBank_accession
Slots.description: The GenBank/ENA/DDBJ identifier assigned to the sequence in the INSDC archives.
Slots.comments: Store the accession returned from a GenBank/ENA/DDBJ submission.

Slots.name: prevalence_metrics
Slots.title: prevalence_metrics
Slots.description: Metrics regarding the prevalence of the pathogen of interest obtained from a surveillance project.
Slots.comments: Risk assessment requires detailed information regarding the quantities of a pathogen in a specified location, commodity, or environment. As such, it is useful for risk assessors to know what types of information are available through documented methods and results. Provide the metric types that are available in the surveillance project sample plan by selecting them from the pick list. The metrics of interest are " Number of total samples collected", "Number of positive samples", "Average count of hazard organism", "Average count of indicator organism". You do not need to provide the actual values, just indicate that the information is available.
Slots.examples: Number of total samples collected, Number of positive samples

Slots.name: prevalence_metrics_details
Slots.title: prevalence_metrics_details
Slots.description: The details pertaining to the prevalence metrics from a surveillance project.
Slots.comments: If there are details pertaining to samples or organism counts in the sample plan that might be informative, provide details using free text.
Slots.examples: Hazard organism counts (i.e. Salmonella) do not distinguish between serovars.

Slots.name: stage_of_production
Slots.title: stage_of_production
Slots.description: The stage of food production.
Slots.comments: Provide the stage of food production as free text.

Slots.name: experimental_intervention
Slots.title: experimental_intervention
Slots.description: The category of the experimental intervention applied in the food production system.
Slots.comments: In some surveys, a particular intervention in the food supply chain in studied. If there was an intervention specified in the sample plan, select the intervention category from the pick list provided.

Slots.name: experiment_intervention_details
Slots.title: experiment_intervention_details
Slots.description: The details of the experimental intervention applied in the food production system.
Slots.comments: If an experimental intervention was applied in the survey, provide details in this field as free text.

Slots.name: amr_testing_by
Slots.title: AMR_testing_by
Slots.description: The name of the organization that performed the antimicrobial resistance testing.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the agency, organization or institution that performed the AMR testing, in full (avoid abbreviations). If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: amr_testing_by_laboratory_name
Slots.title: AMR_testing_by_laboratory_name
Slots.description: The name of the lab within the organization that performed the antimicrobial resistance testing.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the specific laboratory that performed the AMR testing (avoid abbreviations). If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: amr_testing_by_contact_name
Slots.title: AMR_testing_by_contact_name
Slots.description: The name of the individual or the individual's role in the organization that performed the antimicrobial resistance testing.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of an individual or their job title. As personnel turnover may render the contact's name obsolete, it is more preferable to provide a job title for ensuring accuracy of information and institutional memory. If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: amr_testing_by_contact_email
Slots.title: AMR_testing_by_contact_email
Slots.description: The email of the individual or the individual's role in the organization that performed the antimicrobial resistance testing.
Slots.comments: Provide the email associated with the listed contact. As personnel turnover may render an individual's email obsolete, it is more preferable to provide an address for a position or lab, to ensure accuracy of information and institutional memory. If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: amr_testing_date
Slots.title: AMR_testing_date
Slots.description: The date the antimicrobial resistance testing was performed.
Slots.comments: Provide the date according to the ISO 8601 standard "YYYY-MM-DD", "YYYY-MM" or "YYYY".

Slots.name: authors
Slots.title: authors
Slots.description: Names of individuals contributing to the processes of sample collection, sequence generation, analysis, and data submission.
Slots.comments: Include the first and last names of all individuals that should be attributed, separated by a comma.
Slots.examples: Tejinder Singh, Fei Hu, Joe Blogs

Slots.name: dataharmonizer_provenance
Slots.title: DataHarmonizer provenance
Slots.description: The DataHarmonizer software and template version provenance.
Slots.comments: The current software and template version information will be automatically generated in this field after the user utilizes the "validate" function. This information will be generated regardless as to whether the row is valid of not.

Slots.name: alternative_isolate_id
Slots.title: alternative_isolate_ID
Slots.description: An alternative isolate_ID assigned to the isolate by another organization.
Slots.comments:
Alternative isolate IDs should be provided in the in a prescribed format which consists of the ID followed by square brackets (no space in between the ID and bracket) containing the short form of ID provider’s agency name i.e. ID[short organization code]. Agency short forms include the following:
Public Health Agency of Canada: PHAC
Canadian Food Inspection Agency: CFIA
Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada: AAFC
Fisheries and Oceans Canada: DFO
Environment and Climate Change Canada: ECCC
Health Canada: HC 
An example of a properly formatted alternative_isolate_identifier would be e.g. XYZ4567[CFIA]
Multiple alternative isolate IDs can be provided, separated by semi-colons.

Slots.name: progeny_isolate_id
Slots.title: progeny_isolate_ID
Slots.description: The identifier assigned to a progenitor isolate derived from an isolate that was directly obtained from a sample.
Slots.comments: If your sequence data pertains to progeny of an original isolate, provide the progeny_isolate_ID.

Slots.name: irida_isolate_id
Slots.title: IRIDA_isolate_ID
Slots.description: The identifier of the isolate in the IRIDA platform.
Slots.comments: Provide the "sample ID" used to track information linked to the isolate in IRIDA. IRIDA sample IDs should be unqiue to avoid ID clash. This is very important in large Projects, especially when samples are shared from different organizations. Download the IRIDA sample ID and add it to the sample data in your spreadsheet as part of good data management practices.

Slots.name: irida_project_id
Slots.title: IRIDA_project_ID
Slots.description: The identifier of the Project in the iRIDA platform.
Slots.comments: Provide the IRIDA "project ID".

Slots.name: isolated_by
Slots.title: isolated_by
Slots.description: The name of the agency, organization or institution with which the individual who performed the isolation procedure is affiliated.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the agency, organization or institution that isolated the original isolate in full (avoid abbreviations). If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: isolated_by_laboratory_name
Slots.title: isolated_by_laboratory_name
Slots.description: The specific laboratory affiliation of the individual who performed the isolation procedure.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the specific laboratory that that isolated the original isolate (avoid abbreviations). If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: isolated_by_contact_name
Slots.title: isolated_by_contact_name
Slots.description: The name or title of the contact responsible for follow-up regarding the isolate.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of an individual or their job title. As personnel turnover may render the contact's name obsolete, it is prefereable to provide a job title for ensuring accuracy of information and institutional memory. If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: isolated_by_contact_email
Slots.title: isolated_by_contact_email
Slots.description: The email address of the contact responsible for follow-up regarding the isolate.
Slots.comments: Provide the email associated with the listed contact. As personnel turnover may render an individual's email obsolete, it is more prefereable to provide an address for a position or lab, to ensure accuracy of information and institutional memory. If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: isolation_date
Slots.title: isolation_date
Slots.description: The date on which the isolate was isolated from a sample.
Slots.comments: Provide the date according to the ISO 8601 standard "YYYY-MM-DD", "YYYY-MM" or "YYYY".

Slots.name: isolate_received_date
Slots.title: isolate_received_date
Slots.description: The date on which the isolate was received by the laboratory.
Slots.comments: Provide the date according to the ISO 8601 standard "YYYY-MM-DD", "YYYY-MM" or "YYYY".

Slots.name: isolate_id
Slots.title: isolate_ID
Slots.description: The user-defined name for the sample.
Slots.comments: The sample_ID should represent the identifier assigned to the sample at time of collection, for which all the descriptive information applies. If the original sample_ID is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

Slots.name: antimicrobial_drug
Slots.title: antimicrobial_drug
Slots.description: The drug which the pathogen was exposed to.
Slots.comments: Select a drug from the pick list provided.

Slots.name: resistance_phenotype
Slots.title: resistance_phenotype
Slots.description: The antimicrobial resistance phenotype, as determined by the antibiotic susceptibility measurement and testing standard for this antibiotic
Slots.comments: Select a phenotype from the pick list provided.

Slots.name: measurement
Slots.title: measurement
Slots.description: The measured value of amikacin resistance.
Slots.comments: This field should only contain a number (either an integer or a number with decimals).

Slots.name: measurement_units
Slots.title: measurement_units
Slots.description: The units of the antimicrobial resistance measurement.
Slots.comments: Select the units from the pick list provided. Use the Term Request System to request the addition of other units if necessary.

Slots.name: measurement_sign
Slots.title: measurement_sign
Slots.description: The qualifier associated with the antimicrobial resistance measurement
Slots.comments: Select the comparator sign from the pick list provided. Use the Term Request System to request the addition of other signs if necessary.

Slots.name: laboratory_typing_method
Slots.title: laboratory_typing_method
Slots.description: The general method used for antimicrobial susceptibility testing.
Slots.comments: Select a typing method from the pick list provided. Use the Term Request System to request the addition of other methods if necessary.

Slots.name: laboratory_typing_platform
Slots.title: laboratory_typing_platform
Slots.description: The brand/platform used for antimicrobial susceptibility testing.
Slots.comments: Select a typing platform from the pick list provided. Use the Term Request System to request the addition of other platforms if necessary.

Slots.name: laboratory_typing_platform_version
Slots.title: laboratory_typing_platform_version
Slots.description: The specific name and version of the plate, panel, or other platform used for antimicrobial susceptibility testing.
Slots.comments: Include any additional information about the antimicrobial susceptibility test such as the drug panel details.

Slots.name: vendor_name
Slots.title: vendor_name
Slots.description: The name of the vendor of the testing platform used.
Slots.comments: Provide the full name of the company (avoid abbreviations).

Slots.name: testing_standard
Slots.title: testing_standard
Slots.description: The testing standard used for determination of resistance phenotype
Slots.comments: Select a testing standard from the pick list provided.

Slots.name: testing_standard_version
Slots.title: testing_standard_version
Slots.description: The version number associated with the testing standard used for determination of antimicrobial resistance phenotype. If applicable, include a version number for the testing standard used.
Slots.comments: If applicable, include a version number for the testing standard used.

Slots.name: testing_standard_details
Slots.title: testing_standard_details
Slots.description: Additional details associated with the testing standard used for determination of antimicrobial resistance phenotype
Slots.comments: This information may include the year or location where the testing standard was published. If not applicable, leave blank.
Slots.examples: 27th ed. Wayne, PA: Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute;2017.

Slots.name: susceptible_breakpoint
Slots.title: susceptible_breakpoint
Slots.description: The maximum measurement, in the units specified in the “antibiotic_measurement_units” field, for a sample to be considered “sensitive” to this antimicrobial.
Slots.comments: This field should only contain a number (either an integer or a number with decimals), since the “<=” qualifier is implied.

Slots.name: intermediate_breakpoint
Slots.title: intermediate_breakpoint
Slots.description: The intermediate measurement(s), in the units specified in the “AMR_measurement_units” field, where a sample would be considered to have an “intermediate” phenotype for this antimicrobial.

Slots.name: resistant_breakpoint
Slots.title: resistant_breakpoint
Slots.description: The minimum measurement, in the units specified in the “antibiotic_measurement_units” field, for a sample to be considered “resistant” to this antimicrobial.
Slots.comments: This field should only contain a number (either an integer or a number with decimals), since the “>=” qualifier is implied.
